description_en: Asynchronously configures parameters related to the automatic fragment recycling feature for multiple database instances at a time
description_zh: 调用UpdateAutoResourceOptimizeRulesAsync接口，采用异步方式，批量设置指定数据库实例空间碎片自动回收功能的配置参数
name: UpdateAutoResourceOptimizeRulesAsync

parameters.help_en:
The database instance IDs.

Set this parameter to a JSON array that consists of multiple instance IDs. Separate instance IDs with commas (,). Example: `['Instance ID1', 'Instance ID2']`
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例ID。

数据格式为JSONArray，例如`['实例ID1','实例ID2']`，实例ID间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The minimum storage usage that triggers automatic fragment recycling of a single physical table. Valid values: 5 to 100. Unit: GB
parameters.help_zh: 触发空间碎片自动回收单个物理表的最小空间，取值范围：5~100，单位为GB
parameters.name: table_space_size

parameters.help_en: The fragmentation rate that triggers automatic fragment recycling of a single physical table. Valid values: 0.10 to 0.99
parameters.help_zh: 触发空间碎片自动回收单个物理表的碎片率，取值范围：0.10~0.99
parameters.name: table_fragmentation_ratio

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asynchronous request.

Asynchronous calls do not immediately return the complete results. To obtain the complete results, you must use the value of ResultId returned in the response to re-initiate the call until the value of isFinish is true.\\ In this case, you must call this operation at least twice
parameters.help_zh:
异步请求的ID。
异步调用后不会立即返回完整结果，首先需要调用该接口获取ResultId，然后使用返回数据的ResultId，重新发起调用，直到isFinish取值为true时，返回完整结果。即获取一次完整数据，至少需要调用该接口两次
parameters.name: result_id

Complete.description_en:
Indicates whether the asynchronous request was complete. Valid values:

true

false
Complete.description_zh:
异步请求是否执行完成：

true：是。

false：否

ConfigResponse.description_en:
The returned data of the configuration.

The data is returned only if the value of isFinish is true. This value indicates that the asynchronous request is complete
ConfigResponse.description_zh:
批量设置的返回数据。
异步请求完成时（即isFinish取值为true时）才会返回该数据

ConfigFailInstanceList.description_zh: 设置失败的数据库实例列表
